items.explains: Uses data-story bar mode to compare a few supplied values on one zero-based scale.
items.action: Timed labels and values appear as proportional horizontal bars grow from zero.
useWhen: Two to five sourced measurements share one meaningful unit and comparable basis.
avoidWhen: The measurements have different units, missing values or require a logarithmic or negative scale.
The data is a continuous trend that needs time-axis interpretation.
requirements: This is data-story with display:bars and two to five items; takeover is required.
Provide non-negative values with at most two decimals, labels, one unit, source note and ordered cues; all bars settle before scene end.
Catalog provenance points to Motion-Kits/github-curated/manifest.json and needs verification before intake or promotion.

display.explains: وصفة أعمدة بتقارن أرقام على نفس المقياس.
display.useWhen: لقيم موثّقة بوحدة وأساس واحد.
display.avoidWhen: لو الوحدات مختلفة أو القيم سالبة.

items.explains: Uses data-story metric mode to give one supplied value, its unit and source a clear reveal.
items.action: The metric block reveals as its number counts upward and settles at the supplied value.
useWhen: One sourced metric should dominate the explanation without a chart.
avoidWhen: More than one value needs comparison.
The quantity is negative or its source and unit are unknown.
requirements: This is data-story with display:metric and exactly one item, using split or takeover; graphics use takeover.
Provide a non-negative value with at most two decimals, label, unit, source note and reveal frame; finish its animation before scene end.
Catalog provenance points to Motion-Kits/github-curated/manifest.json and needs verification before intake or promotion.

display.explains: وصفة بتبرز رقم واحد ووحدته ومصدره.
display.useWhen: لما رقم واحد كفاية يشرح النقطة.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج نقارن أكتر من قيمة.

items.explains: Uses screen-focus to explain an authored region of an actual screenshot or separate capture.
items.action: Reveals real media and moves focus to source-aligned regions, with optional video cursor, click and callouts.
useWhen: A real source detail should substantiate a tutorial step or visual claim.
avoidWhen: The source is absent or only a fabricated UI could support the explanation.
The main recording is already the continuous screen source and needs screen-recording instead.
requirements: This is a recipe variant of screen-focus, not an additional scene family; use its takeover schema and source geometry contract.
Supply an actual still or local MP4/WebM capture with accurate dimensions and authored focus timing.
Catalog provenance points to Motion-Kits/github-curated/manifest.json and needs verification before intake or promotion.

display.explains: وصفة لتوضيح جزء محدد من المصدر الحقيقي.
display.useWhen: لشرح تفصيلة على الشاشة بدليلها.
display.avoidWhen: لو المصدر مش موجود أو الشاشة هي التسجيل الأساسي.

items.explains: Introduces a chapter and gives a supplied quotation clear speaker attribution.
items.action: The chapter heading holds, then the quotation reveals; an optional approved magazine foreground appears before the quote.
useWhen: A real quotation or interview statement anchors a new section.
A reflective passage needs space for the speaker's exact attributed words.
avoidWhen: The quote or speaker identity is uncertain.
The passage needs automatic word-by-word synchronization or an unapproved generated likeness.
requirements: Supply chapter, title, quote, speaker, role and a quoteFrame inside the scene; quote copy is independently authored and must be verified.
Optional cover foreground requires a supplied transparent PNG, hash, dimensions and safe placement; it is available only in magazine-interview with takeover and a positive quoteFrame.
Without a cover, split or takeover is available; no automatic source word-index dependency exists.

display.explains: بيفتح فصل باقتباس واضح وصاحبه معروف.
display.useWhen: لجملة منسوبة بتقود الفكرة.
display.avoidWhen: لو النص أو هوية صاحبه مش مؤكّدين.

items.explains: Shows a small set of missing or planned items and activates each at its authored cue.
items.action: Numbered rows become highlighted; missing-state details resolve or blueprint ticks become visible.
useWhen: Checking up to five requirements or practical actions.
Contrasting what is missing with what the supplied plan includes.
avoidWhen: The viewer must see causal flow, branches or a detailed tutorial.
The check marks would imply real completion that has not occurred.
requirements: Choose missing or blueprint; supply one to five rows with label, detail and ordered activation frames.
An optional local image supports the checklist; it is not mandatory.
Takeover only; labels should describe the intended explanation rather than invent completed work.

display.explains: بيفعّل بنود قائمة واحدة واحدة.
display.useWhen: للشروط أو الخطوات العملية القصيرة.
display.avoidWhen: لو علامة الصح هتدّعي إن حاجة اتنفذت.

items.explains: Shows the exact approved keyword a viewer can comment and the promised response.
items.action: A comment input reveals the keyword with a reading-direction wipe, with the promise beneath it.
useWhen: An approved call to action asks viewers to comment one keyword for a real resource.
avoidWhen: No keyword or resource promise has been approved.
The intended action is following, buying or visiting a link rather than commenting.
requirements: Use the creator's actual CTA keyword, up to 20 characters, and truthful promise up to 52.
This illustrates a comment action; it does not submit a comment or deliver the resource.

display.explains: بيوضح كلمة الكومنت والوعد المرتبط بيها.
display.useWhen: لما طلب الكومنت متفق عليه.
display.avoidWhen: لو مفيش كلمة أو هدية معتمدة.

items.explains: Collects a few supplied audience comments or questions and connects them to an approved response prompt.
items.action: One to three author-labelled comment cards reveal in order above the keyword and prompt.
useWhen: Answering real audience questions or grouping a small discussion.
An approved comment request follows the displayed context.
avoidWhen: Invented authors or comments would look like real testimonials.
The viewer needs a full conversation or more than three comments.
requirements: Supply one to three short comments, their actual attribution and strictly ordered cues.
Use the approved keyword and prompt; clearly identify illustrative comments when they are not real audience evidence.
This is a visual discussion summary, without live social-network access.

display.explains: بيجمع شوية أسئلة أو تعليقات مع طلب الرد.
display.useWhen: للرد على أسئلة جمهور حقيقية.
display.avoidWhen: لو التعليقات مؤلّفة وهتبان كشهادات.

items.explains: Contrasts two short descriptions of the same subject, such as before and after.
items.action: Two labelled cards enter side by side or stack according to the selected style grammar.
useWhen: Contrasting two approaches using concise labels and descriptions.
Explaining what changes between two states without image evidence.
avoidWhen: The viewer needs to inspect actual before/after images.
Unequal metrics or unrelated subjects would create a misleading comparison.
requirements: Supply both labels and details under one title; descriptions are explanatory copy, not measured evidence.
The selected style chooses side-by-side or stacked composition; use evidence-wipe for aligned real-image comparison.

display.explains: بيقارن حالتين بوصف مختصر.
display.useWhen: لما الفرق يتفهم بالكلام.
display.avoidWhen: لو لازم نشوف صور الدليل نفسها.

items.explains: Emphasizes one supplied whole-number quantity while preserving a presenter window below.
items.action: The number rolls at an authored cue, then its unit and optional badge appear.
useWhen: A spoken count needs a clear number and a separately timed unit.
The presenter should remain visible during the metric.
avoidWhen: There is no presenter recording or the scene needs a full-frame graphic.
The quantity needs decimals, negative values or a multi-value comparison.
requirements: Split layout only; supply an integer from 0 to 999999 and its unit. The suffix is optional and blank by default; add one such as + only when the source says it.
The roll must finish inside the scene; time the unit and optional badge deliberately.
The family has no source-note field, so keep the quantity supported by the recording or reviewed evidence.

display.explains: رقم بيعدّ ومعاه وحدته فوق المتحدث.
display.useWhen: لما العدد جزء مهم من الكلام.
display.avoidWhen: للجرافيكس الصامتة أو الأرقام العشرية.

items.explains: Stages an approved comment request and follow identity around the presenter.
items.action: A title and keyword prompt land, followed by the handle and an illustrative follow-button state change.
useWhen: A presenter-led ending explicitly includes both a keyword request and a follow card.
avoidWhen: Only a follow or only a comment request is approved.
The simulated button change could be mistaken for an actual account action.
requirements: Presenter layout only; use the actual keyword, prompt and complete @handle. Write {keyword} in the prompt where the keyword appears; delivery refuses a prompt that never shows it.
Author followFrame then clickedFrame in order inside the scene.
The button animation is illustrative; preserve the approved ending order and recorded sign-off.

display.explains: بيجمع كلمة الكومنت والمتابعة مع المتحدث.
display.useWhen: لخاتمة الاتنين متفق عليهم فيها.
display.avoidWhen: لو المطلوب متابعة بس أو كومنت بس.

items.explains: Presents supplied quantitative evidence as one metric or a small shared-scale bar comparison.
items.action: Authored values reveal and count upward; metric mode emphasizes one value, while bars grow from zero on one scale.
useWhen: One sourced metric needs its unit, label and source note.
Two to five comparable values should be read on a common zero-based scale.
avoidWhen: Values are negative, exceed two decimal places or lack a common comparable unit.
A causal change or trend over continuous time is being inferred from unrelated numbers.
requirements: Supply non-negative values up to 999999999 with at most two decimals, labels, unit and sourceNote.
Metric display requires exactly one value and allows split or takeover; bars require two to five values and takeover.
Order reveal frames and finish every animateFrames interval before scene end; graphics always use takeover.

display.explains: بيحوّل البيانات لرقم واضح أو أعمدة مقارنة.
display.useWhen: لما فيه أرقام موثّقة بوحدة واحدة.
display.avoidWhen: للأرقام السالبة أو مقارنة وحدات مختلفة.

items.explains: Reveals the visible difference between two supplied before/after images in one comparison window.
items.action: A reading-direction wipe replaces the before image with the after image while labels and an explanatory footer stay available.
useWhen: The same subject has comparable before and after views.
The viewer should inspect evidence rather than read a verbal claim.
avoidWhen: The images show unrelated subjects or incompatible framing that hides what changed.
A moving-video comparison or unverified result is needed.
requirements: Supply two local images, their actual dimensions, labels and a truthful footer; the renderer uses contain fitting.
Author revealFrame, duration and rtl/ltr direction so the wipe finishes inside the scene and the final image can be read.
Both split and takeover are available; graphics use takeover.

display.explains: بيكشف الفرق بين قبل وبعد في نفس النافذة.
display.useWhen: لما عندك صورتين دليل لنفس الحاجة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الزوايا أو المحتوى مش قابلين للمقارنة.

items.explains: Identifies the creator account and gives one reason to follow it.
items.action: A large complete handle and short follow message appear as a final card.
useWhen: An approved ending needs the creator's complete account handle.
The viewer should know where to find more of the same material.
avoidWhen: The account identity is unknown or the ending has no approved follow request.
The card would interrupt the recorded goodbye.
requirements: Supply a complete @handle using 1 to 30 allowed handle characters after @ and a message up to 72 characters.
Place the card in the approved ending order with time to read the full identity.

display.explains: بيعرّف الحساب وسبب المتابعة.
display.useWhen: لخاتمة فيها متابعة متفق عليها.
display.avoidWhen: لو هيقطع الوداع أو الحساب مش معروف.

items.explains: Connects short gliding text and optional bullets to actual supplied media inside one stable card.
items.action: The bevelled card stays still while image/video clips cut within it and timed words, box text and bullets arrive around it.
useWhen: A Grid Glide tutorial or result needs real media as its anchor.
Short claims or feature bullets can be supported by visible source clips.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not grid-glide or media is missing.
The important detail cannot survive cover cropping, or a camera zoom inside the source is needed.
requirements: Owned by grid-glide and takeover only; supply one to six local image/video clips with hash and actual dimensions.
First clip starts at zero and clips are strictly ordered; media uses cover fitting, videos play muted, and only stills may use scroll.
At most four lines with six words each, four short bullets and one optional box; text must pass the style's layout and fit checks.
Scene enter/exit timing and adjacent dip pairing follow Grid Glide's fixed motion law.

display.explains: كارت ثابت بيعرض لقطات حقيقية وكلام قصير حواليه.
display.useWhen: لشرح أداة أو نتيجة معاها دليل بصري.
display.avoidWhen: من غير ميديا أو لو القصّ هيخفي التفصيلة.

items.explains: Marks one short chapter or ordinal and optionally names the tool used in that section.
items.action: One or two ordinal words glide upward; an optional tool pill slides in afterward.
useWhen: A Grid Glide sequence needs a brief chapter boundary.
A tool or section label should follow one dominant ordinal.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not grid-glide.
The chapter needs a paragraph, split presenter layout or an immediate cut before the title can be read.
requirements: Owned by grid-glide and takeover only; ordinal is at most two words and 30 characters.
Minimum duration is 60 frames at 30 fps, scaled to the edit fps; the pill cannot precede the ordinal.
A logo is optional but needs its actual hash and dimensions; motion uses the style's fixed law rather than the common motion enum.
Dip exits and entries must pair across immediately adjacent Grid Glide scenes.

display.explains: فاصل قصير لفصل أو أداة في ستايل كلمات وكروت.
display.useWhen: لترتيب الشرح لفصول واضحة.
display.avoidWhen: مع ستايل تاني أو عنوان طويل.

items.explains: Makes the approved comment keyword the dominant final instruction in a Grid Glide ending.
items.action: Lead-in lines glide up, the keyword becomes the hero and an optional promise box wipes in afterward.
useWhen: An approved Grid Glide ending asks for one specific comment keyword.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not grid-glide or no CTA keyword is approved.
The ending has too little room for the final instruction to settle and hold.
requirements: Owned by grid-glide and takeover only; the actual CTA keyword is at most 20 characters and three words.
Supply one to three lead-in lines; keyword cannot precede the final lead-in and a box cannot precede the keyword.
The last ending element must settle and hold at least 24 frames at 30 fps, scaled to fps, before the exit.
Keep any promised resource truthful and preserve the approved sign-off order.

display.explains: بيخلي كلمة الكومنت هي أهم حاجة في الخاتمة.
display.useWhen: لطلب كومنت معتمد بستيل كلمات وكروت.
display.avoidWhen: لو الكلمة مش معتمدة أو الخاتمة مستعجلة.

items.explains: Makes the creator's complete account handle the final visual identity in a Grid Glide ending.
items.action: Optional lead-in lines precede the large handle, then a follow pill slides in and the ending holds.
useWhen: An approved Grid Glide ending needs a clear follow destination.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not grid-glide or the actual handle is unknown.
The identity would be clipped, rushed or placed over the recorded goodbye.
requirements: Owned by grid-glide and takeover only; use the complete validated @handle and an approved follow pill label.
At most two lead-in lines; the handle follows their cues and the pill cannot precede the handle.
The last element must settle and hold at least 24 frames at 30 fps, scaled to fps, before the exit; fit checks protect the complete handle.
The follow pill is text only and has no logo tile.

display.explains: بيختم بالحساب كامل وزر متابعة بصري.
display.useWhen: لخاتمة متابعة بستيل كلمات وكروت.
display.avoidWhen: لو الحساب مجهول أو مفيش وقت لقراءته.

items.explains: Builds a concise authored statement from timed lines without needing an image or literal recorded-word indices.
items.action: Short lead and hero lines glide into their final positions with an optional wipe-revealed box and background grid.
useWhen: A Grid Glide hook or statement should be understood through a few short text lines.
The message can be authored as visual copy rather than a literal subtitle.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not grid-glide.
Long prose, exact word timestamps or a relational diagram is needed.
requirements: Owned by grid-glide and takeover only; provide one to five lines with one to six words each.
Author line start cues and a 4 to 9 frame base cadence; rows must fit the safe width at the style's actual font size.
No reviewed-words dependency exists; timing is authored and follows Grid Glide's fixed motion law.
Pair any dip boundary with an immediately adjacent Grid Glide scene.

display.explains: بيبني جملة قصيرة من سطور بتتحرك لمكانها.
display.useWhen: لهوك أو فكرة مختصرة بستيل كلمات وكروت.
display.avoidWhen: للنص الطويل أو توقيت الكلام كلمة بكلمة.

items.explains: Places two supplied images together so the viewer can compare their visible differences.
items.action: Two labelled image cards land at opposite angles and a short concluding stamp follows.
useWhen: Two distinct examples or alternatives should remain visible together.
A visual difference is readable even in a cropped portrait card.
avoidWhen: The comparison needs aligned geometry, a wipe or uncropped interface details.
The images do not show comparable subjects or the stamp overstates what they prove.
requirements: Exactly two local images with labels are required; they render with cover cropping into fixed card windows.
Takeover only; keep important details inside each image's visible crop.
Use evidence-wipe when the same subject must align before and after.

display.explains: بيحط صورتين جنب بعض عشان الفرق يبان.
display.useWhen: لمثالين ينفع يتشافوا مع بعض.
display.avoidWhen: لو لازم نحافظ على كل تفاصيل الصورة.

items.explains: Names one topic and gives the viewer its central idea before the explanation develops.
items.action: A heading introduces the topic and a single card reveals its short supporting statement.
useWhen: Opening a topic or a new section with one clear premise.
Giving a short question its context before showing an answer.
avoidWhen: The message needs a changing object, a measurable comparison or several steps.
The subtitle is too long to read as one card.
requirements: Supply kicker, title, subtitle and explanatory caption; this family does not select recorded words.
Uses split or takeover; source-free graphics require takeover.

display.explains: بيقدّم فكرة واحدة ومعاها توضيح قصير.
display.useWhen: لما تبدأ موضوع أو فصل جديد.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج تشرح حركة أو خطوات.

items.explains: Turns a short first statement into a second one while the presenter remains the anchor.
items.action: A large title swaps at an authored cue; an underline changes colour and a later stamp lands.
useWhen: Opening a presenter-led passage with a short reversal or corrected expectation.
The two titles and final stamp form one clear thought.
avoidWhen: There is no presenter recording.
The explanation needs a literal word-by-word transcript or a long title.
requirements: Presenter layout only; each swapped title has at most 36 characters.
Author swapFrame and stampFrame inside the scene.
An optional transparent foreground must match the same source hash and uninterrupted source frames; never substitute an unrelated cutout.

display.explains: عنوان قصير بيتحوّل لفكرة تانية قدام المتحدث.
display.useWhen: للهوك اللي فيه مفاجأة أو تصحيح.
display.avoidWhen: من غير تسجيل متحدث أو مع عنوان طويل.

items.explains: Makes selected literal recorded words visually prominent at their actual source timing.
items.action: Mapped words enter at their surviving recording cues, with optional per-word accent, weight, underline or pop emphasis.
useWhen: The exact words and timing of a short recorded phrase matter.
Emphasizing a key term without replacing the speaker's language.
avoidWhen: There is no recording or the text is newly authored explanatory copy.
Selected words cross cuts, fall outside the scene or have unreviewed timing.
requirements: Select one to 32 strictly ordered source word indices in Arabic or English; every word must survive cuts and remain wholly inside the scene.
Emphasis marks can reference only selected source indices; rise, pop and fade are the supported word entrances.
Split or takeover is supported; this family cannot be used for source-free graphics or invented transcripts.

display.explains: بيحرّك نفس الكلمات المسجّلة على توقيتها.
display.useWhen: لما اللفظ نفسه مهم في الجملة.
display.avoidWhen: للجرافيكس من غير تسجيل أو كلام مؤلّف.

items.explains: Organizes the same supplied message cards into a board, then focuses one useful result.
items.action: Three to six identified cards start scattered, gather into order and resolve into a focused card, with optional closing state.
useWhen: Showing how several inputs become organized and one result is chosen.
The identity of the same messages must remain visible through the explanation.
avoidWhen: There are fewer than three inputs or no defensible focused result.
The passage is too short for initial reading, organization and final focus holds.
requirements: Takeover only; supply three to six unique card IDs and a focusIndex that selects an existing card.
Hold initial cards at least 0.6 seconds, the organized board at least 0.75 seconds, and the focused result at least one second.
If using closingFrame, leave at least one second before closing and one second for the closing state.

display.explains: بينظّم نفس الرسايل وبيركّز على نتيجة منها.
display.useWhen: لما المدخلات الكتير توصل لنتيجة واضحة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الوقت مش مكفّي مراحل الفهم.

items.explains: Compares exactly two supplied quantities against one declared maximum and common unit.
items.action: Two labelled receipt rows appear in order and their meters fill proportionally to the shared maximum.
useWhen: A two-option numeric difference should be understood at a glance.
The scale ceiling itself is meaningful and can be stated honestly.
avoidWhen: The two rows use different units or no shared maximum is defensible.
More than two measurements or negative values are needed.
requirements: Exactly two non-negative values with up to two decimals, one positive maximum, one unit and source text are required.
Neither value may exceed the maximum; reveal rows in strictly increasing order.
Leave time for each meter's 18-frame fill and final comparison hold.

display.explains: بيقارن قيمتين على نفس السقف والوحدة.
display.useWhen: لفرق رقمي واضح بين اختيارين.
display.avoidWhen: لو الوحدات مختلفة أو السقف مضلّل.

items.explains: Hosts one registered motion concept with that concept's own explanatory action and editable data.
items.action: The selected catalog component runs once on the takeover canvas using its original config schema.
useWhen: A specific catalog concept matches the intended change, grouping, flow or reveal.
The concept's own timeline and data contract can express the explanation.
avoidWhen: Treating this wrapper as one additional explanatory concept.
Choosing by motion alone without checking the child concept's meaning, assets and minimum duration.
requirements: Takeover only; select a registered concept and validate config against its own schema.
Use the child's semantic metadata, asset requirements and minimum duration scaled to the edit frame rate.
The wrapper itself does not imply that every concept suits every intent or mood.

display.explains: بيشغّل واحد من مشاهد الشرح الجاهزة.
display.useWhen: لما مشهد بعينه يخدم معنى الفكرة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الاختيار لمجرد إن الحركة شكلها حلو.

items.explains: Connects a short authored product workflow from input and choices to a textual reel result in one continuous visual take.
items.action: The start button expands into a UI world; file/input, toggle or metric worlds open from each other, the result becomes a reel, and the camera returns to the starting page.
useWhen: A one-shot product explanation needs one to four compatible authored steps.
The input, configuration and result can be represented honestly as an illustrated interface journey.
avoidWhen: The selected style is not one-shot or the passage needs split presenter footage.
The viewer needs actual software captures, arbitrary branching or proof that the illustrated jobs ran.
The available duration cannot fit the data-dependent authored chain.
requirements: Owned by one-shot and takeover only; provide brand, intro, one to four steps, four to six short result words and closing copy whose headline, sub and platforms fit one column: the validator refuses a closing that would end below y 1458 and says what to shorten.
Supported steps are drop, field, toggle, stat and work; begin with drop/field/stat, follow a drop with field, alternate dark/accent worlds otherwise, keep work last and never finish on toggle.
Field copy is at most six words and 34 characters, or 22 beside a dropped file; toggles need at least one on option and work has two to four job labels.

Use oneShotMinFrames for the actual data and fps; the authored timing includes the result, pullback and return hold rather than arbitrary per-step cues. Extra scene duration holds the initial home view after the chain; it does not extend the illustrated processing.
No actual file import, typing, processing or platform posting occurs; substantiate any supplied statistic and label the journey as an illustration when needed.

display.explains: بيوصل المدخلات والاختيارات بالنتيجة في لقطة متصلة.
display.useWhen: لشرح منتج بخطوات قصيرة وواجهة توضيحية.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج تسجيل حقيقي أو الوقت مش مكفّي السلسلة.

items.explains: Turns a whole recording into an illustrated explainer: a drawn narrator points at simple cards while the headline builds on the recorded words and the grounds flip between acts.
items.action: Paper and night grounds alternate through a circle opening from the narrator’s head; each act’s cards land on word anchors, the narrator points, opens its hands or rests its chin on a fist, and its mouth follows the recording’s loudness.
useWhen: The creator wants a faceless explainer: the recording is the voice and an illustrated narrator stands in on screen.
Each sentence carries one idea that a generic card (term, windows, fan, code, link, grid, crossed, stack, nodes, morph, monitor, timer) can show honestly.
avoidWhen: The creator’s face, a presenter window or real footage is the point of the video.
There is no recording (graphics mode) or the transcript is not reviewed: every time is a word anchor.
A passage needs a claim, number or keyword that the recording does not say.
requirements: Owned by the cartoon style and takeover only; the brief sets sourceKind "cartoon" and the cartoon scenes must cover the whole edit.

Sentences tile the reviewed words in order (1 to 12 words, at most three headline lines, two over a monitor card); acts alternate paper and night, last at least 3 s and flip 0.2 to 0.5 s before their first word.
Cards hold creator copy and icons from the fixed list; a seconds counter or a timer card needs the number spoken at its saidAt word.
Prepare builds prepared/mouth.json from the recording; authored places stay inside the narrator safe box measured for the chosen character.
It is a newer style: show the fast preview first and have the creator play the delivered video with sound.

display.explains: شخصية مرسومة بتشرح بدالك على صوتك وبتشاور على الكروت.
display.useWhen: لفيديو شرح من غير ما تظهر، وكل جملة فيها فكرة واحدة.
display.avoidWhen: لو وشك هو المهم أو مفيش تسجيل.

items.explains: Closes a cartoon video: the comment keyword and/or a follow card with the character’s own head as the avatar, then a quiet tail in which the narrator waves over the recorded sign-off.
items.action: The last act opens with the reveal, the comment card shows this video’s keyword, the follow card is tapped and reads Following, and from the sign-off’s first word the band, headline and cards are gone while the narrator waves in the centre.
useWhen: A cartoon body is the edit and the profile has a CTA keyword, the follow card, or both on for this video.
The recorded sign-off should stay audible under a waving narrator with no text or sound over it.
avoidWhen: The style is not cartoon, or no cartoon body ends exactly where this scene starts.
Neither the comment CTA nor the follow card is on for this video.
requirements: Owned by the cartoon style; it starts where the body ends, fromTheme equals the body’s last act theme and differs in ground from theme.
The keyword equals this video’s CTA keyword and the handle the complete profile handle; comment comes before follow and the tap after the follow card.
With the recorded sign-off on, tail.at sits on its first word, the scene runs to the edit end and nothing sounds at or after the tail.

display.explains: نهاية فيها الكومنت والمتابعة والشخصية بتعمل باي على السلام.
display.useWhen: لآخر فيديو كارتون فيه دعوة تعليق أو متابعة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الستايل مش كارتون أو مفيش دعوة للفيديو ده.

items.explains: Summarizes a small set of outcomes or benefits while retaining the presenter below.
items.action: A heading lands, then short result tags appear together and a concluding footer follows.
useWhen: Closing a presenter-led explanation with concise supported takeaways.
Several short result labels share one conclusion.
avoidWhen: There is no presenter recording or a takeover is needed.
Each item requires its own activation timing or evidence.
requirements: Split layout only; provide one to six short items plus kicker, title and footer.
The tags enter at local frame 25 and footer at 50; leave room afterward for a readable conclusion.
Do not promote a promised benefit into a verified result without support.

display.explains: بيجمع الخلاصة في كلمات قصيرة فوق المتحدث.
display.useWhen: لنتايج أو فوائد واضحة في آخر الشرح.
display.avoidWhen: من غير متحدث أو لو كل نتيجة محتاجة دليل.

items.explains: Breaks a procedure into exactly three named steps with short details.
items.action: Three numbered cards enter in order and remain available to read together.
useWhen: Explaining a compact three-step workflow.
Showing the viewer a short sequence they can follow.
avoidWhen: The process needs branches, feedback or objects visibly transforming between stages.
There are fewer or more than three meaningful steps.
requirements: Exactly three steps are required; each has a title up to 26 characters and detail up to 44.
The family provides ordered cards, not a semantic input-to-output flow; use a suitable concept or project scene when identity must move through the process.

display.explains: بيبسّط طريقة الشغل في ٣ خطوات.
display.useWhen: لما التسلسل قصير وواضح.
display.avoidWhen: لو فيه تفرعات أو أكتر من ٣ خطوات.

items.explains: Provides a project-local component route when shipped families cannot express the required explanatory action.
items.action: A declared TSX/JSX component receives validated editable values and the current scene's style, layout and duration. A clip field can place a registered silent clip anywhere in the scene.
useWhen: A custom diagram, state change or visual metaphor needs authored object behavior.
The project's declared component and reviewed copy already define a concrete explanation.
avoidWhen: A shipped family already serves the meaning adequately.
There is no inspectable project-local component and editable field contract.
requirements: Declare a scene pack in this same project with a local TSX/JSX entry and bounded editable fields; scene values must match that component's contract.
Split or takeover is available; source-free graphics require takeover, and custom split code must respect seam, head geometry and safe zones.

Assets depend on declared asset fields and must be local and verified. A moving clip goes in a clip field registered with node scripts/clips.mjs add and is drawn with SceneClip; importing OffthreadVideo or Video directly is refused.
Code or contract changes require preparation and editor reload; this extension is not one universal ready-made visual.

display.explains: بيسمح بمشهد مكتوب مخصوص لمعنى المشروع.
display.useWhen: لما الجاهز مش قادر يشرح الفكرة صح.
display.avoidWhen: لو مفيش كود وعقد حقول واضح للمشهد.

items.explains: Makes one supplied whole-number quantity prominent while keeping its source visible.
items.action: A value rolls from zero into a large final number above a source line.
useWhen: Supporting a statement with one sourced count.
Giving a single result or inventory quantity visual weight.
avoidWhen: The number has decimals, is negative or must be compared on a shared scale.
No evidence supports the quantity or its meaning.
requirements: Supply an integer from 0 to 999999, label, suffix and source; the renderer does not verify the claim.
Allow the roughly 1.15-second number roll to settle and leave a readable final hold.
Use data-story metric for supported decimals or data-story bars for a shared-scale comparison.

display.explains: بيبرز رقم واحد ومصدره.
display.useWhen: لما رقم موثّق يثبت النقطة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الرقم بلا مصدر أو محتاج مقارنة.

items.explains: Shows a short ordered journey as two to four labelled stops on one continuing route.
items.action: Numbered stops reveal in order and the connecting path fills as the journey advances.
useWhen: A progression or learning path has two to four meaningful milestones.
The viewer should keep the overall route visible while each stop arrives.
avoidWhen: Geographic accuracy, real map geometry or branching routes are required.
The stops are unrelated points rather than an ordered journey.
requirements: Supply two to four stops with short labels, details and strictly ordered reveal frames.
Each stop may include a supplied local image; the route itself is schematic and does not represent measured geography.
Use the footer for the journey's conclusion rather than adding an unrelated new step.

display.explains: بيمشي في رحلة قصيرة من محطة للتانية.
display.useWhen: للمراحل أو محطات التعلّم المتتابعة.
display.avoidWhen: للخرايط الدقيقة أو الطرق المتفرعة.

items.explains: Directs attention to a specific authored region of supplied screenshots or a separate screen capture.
items.action: A real source fills a framed viewport; the camera moves to a chosen region with aligned focus marks, optional cursor and callouts.
useWhen: A tutorial depends on a real control, detail or visible result.
A separate capture should support a presenter-led recording or source-free explanation.
avoidWhen: No real source media or accurate source dimensions exist.
The main recording itself is the continuous screen source; prefer screen-recording for that case.
requirements: Takeover only; supply one to six local still or MP4/WebM capture steps with real dimensions and normalized focus rectangles.
First step starts at zero; focus moves must settle before the next step or scene end.
Video uses explicit camera keys, optional cursor waypoints and source-pinned callouts; playback is muted.

display.explains: بيقرّب على تفصيلة محددة في شاشة حقيقية.
display.useWhen: لزرار أو نتيجة محتاجة تتشاف بوضوح.
display.avoidWhen: لو مفيش لقطة حقيقية أو أبعاد دقيقة.

items.explains: Follows important regions of the edit's actual continuous screen recording.
items.action: The prepared source plate plays continuously under camera keys, source-aligned click ripples and timed rectangle or circle marks.
useWhen: The main named recording is a screen capture and the presenter is absent.
A tutorial needs camera focus while preserving the recorded screen action.
avoidWhen: The main recording is a presenter or the screen clip is a separate supporting asset.
There is no real screen recording, or the planned zoom destroys source legibility.
requirements: Takeover only with presenter:false and a prepared screen-only main source; no per-scene src is supplied.
First camera key starts at zero; keys are strictly ordered and moves finish inside the scene.
Respect the source upscale limit and keep marked regions inside the safe zone; use screen-focus for separate capture assets.

display.explains: بيتابع التفاصيل جوّه تسجيل الشاشة الأساسي.
display.useWhen: لشرح شاشة مسجلة من غير متحدث ظاهر.
display.avoidWhen: لو الشاشة ملف مساعد لفيديو متحدث.

items.explains: Walks through a short sequence of supplied screens or visual results with one title per step; its B-roll look instead plays short silent clips from files the creator named over the continuing voice.
items.action: A framed viewport switches between authored image or muted-video steps and updates its progress markers. In the B-roll look a registered clip fills the full screen or the area above the presenter, changes by hard cuts and may carry a short label.
useWhen: Showing a screen sequence where whole-step context matters more than precise focus tracking.
Revealing supplied interface states or outputs in order.
Illustrating what the speaker names with a short real clip (the B-roll look): start on the cue word and keep it to one to three seconds.
avoidWhen: A small control needs a source-aligned zoom, cursor or pinned callout.
The supplied video needs its audio or the result is not available as real media.
The B-roll look would be used as proof of a result, or the style is cartoon, one-shot or grid-glide, which draw their own screen.
requirements: Supply one to six local image/video steps; first atFrame is zero and later cues are strictly ordered.
Each step chooses contain or cover; video is muted and uses its authored trimBeforeFrame.
Window look: takeover only; use screen-focus for explicit region focus and pinned annotations.

B-roll look: clips only from files the creator named, registered with node scripts/clips.mjs add (silent, SDR, at the project frame rate); full screen or split, enlarged at most 1.25x, never over the ending.

display.explains: بيمشي على شاشات أو نتايج حقيقية بالترتيب، وبشكل B-roll بيعرض لقطة قصيرة صامتة فوق كلامك.
display.useWhen: لشرح مراحل كل واحدة ليها شاشة، أو لتوضيح اللي بتقوله بلقطة قصيرة.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج تكبير زرار أو مؤشر دقيق، أو لو اللقطة هتتحط كدليل على نتيجة.

items.explains: Gives one short spoken idea a persistent visual label while the presenter remains visible.
items.action: A coloured title strip lifts into place and adapts its vertical position to the prepared head guide.
useWhen: A presenter-led point needs one concise headline.
The face should remain the main visual while a claim is reinforced.
avoidWhen: The text needs word-by-word timing.
The statement needs evidence, a diagram or several supporting lines to make sense.
requirements: Presenter layout only; supply kicker and title, keeping the title short enough for two lines.
Use prepared head geometry to protect the presenter; this title is explanatory copy, not a literal transcript.

display.explains: بيبرز جملة قصيرة جنب حضور المتحدث.
display.useWhen: لتأكيد نقطة واحدة في الكلام.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج مزامنة كل كلمة.

items.explains: Makes one real invitation or offer concrete through its label, value and short conditions.
items.action: A ticket-shaped card reveals its offer while a footer carries the actual conditions.
useWhen: An approved session, resource or invitation benefits from one tangible offer card.
avoidWhen: The price, entitlement or conditions are unknown.
The ticket styling could imply a booking, scarcity or purchase that did not happen.
requirements: Supply the actual ticket label, value, detail and footer; the value is text rather than a computed price.
Place the ticket activation inside the scene and hold its conditions long enough to read.
No booking or commerce action occurs in this renderer.

display.explains: بيقدّم عرض حقيقي في شكل تذكرة.
display.useWhen: لدعوة أو عرض شروطه واضحة.
display.avoidWhen: لو السعر أو الاستحقاق لسه مش محدد.

items.explains: Divides an idea into labelled token groups and magnifies one chosen piece.
items.action: Token groups reveal in order, then one real token is highlighted and repeated inside a lens.
useWhen: Explaining parts of a short phrase, category or structured input.
One element deserves attention within a visible group.
avoidWhen: The tokens are too long to fit compact chips.
The explanation needs actual code execution or literal recorded-word timing.
requirements: Supply one to three groups with one to six short tokens per group; lens indices must point to a supplied token.
The lens cue cannot precede its group's reveal; group cues are strictly ordered.
These are authored explanatory tokens, without a recording-word dependency.

display.explains: بيقسّم الفكرة لأجزاء ويكبّر جزء محدد.
display.useWhen: لتوضيح كلمة أو عنصر جوّه مجموعة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الأجزاء طويلة أو محتاجة توقيت الكلام.
